_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Shaman tracks. gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped -- re-check them after a mythicsim-forever-engine pull. Forever notes: the shaman kit gained new core spells (Riptide and Lava Lash join the shock/cooldown families, Molten Blast, Healing Rain, Decoy Totem, Stoneclaw Totem, Earthbind Totem, Feral Spirit, Rage of the Farseer, Totemic Projection); the Far Sight scry line is split into Call of the Elements/Spirits/Ancestors (L20/30/40) and Call of Flame/Thunder (L60); melee 'stamps' are Windfury/Flametongue/Rockbiter Weapon + Frostbrand. Shocks and totems often carry the cooldown as a shared category cooldown (e.g. shock category, Mana Tide category 591) -- the generator emits CategoryCooldownMs as cooldownMs.
